recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: Thank you, Madam President. Madam Leader, thank you. And as always, eloquent. Senator Cleare, thank you for your words, and Senator Webb, and everybody, all of my colleagues who will after me say incredibly eloquent things about living history. We've read history books, we learn about Black history. But when you've been able to be around and have actual, meaningful conversation with someone who is…
